sourceDocuments.notes: Publisher question-bank book (Udvash Academic & Admission Care), scanned PDF, 295 pp. Set-A of JU D Unit 2020-2021 occupies book PDF pp.131-133 (printed book pp.130-132): questions pp.131-133, printed answer table ('উত্তরমালা ও ব্যাখ্যামূলক সমাধান') on p.133 followed by printed worked solutions for selected questions (03, 05, 06, 11, 19, 28, 29, 39, 44, 46, 55, 56, 57, 60) — every worked-solution key agrees with the answer table; the Q06 solution explicitly declares no correct answer, matching the table's dash. LAYOUT: the book re-sorts this paper under syllabus headings — 'Short Syllabus' (pp.131-132) and 'Extra Syllabus' (bottom of p.132, continued at the top of p.133) — so the printed question numbers are scattered across the three pages rather than sequential; the pack preserves the printed numbering. No printed subject headings; subjects assigned by printed number ranges/content in the unit's standard structure: Bangla Q1-3, English Q4-6, IQ Q7-9, Biology Q10-43 (Botany Q10-25, Zoology Q26-43), Chemistry Q44-60. Transcription by direct visual reading of every page at 300 dpi with zoomed re-reads of the header, the answer table, the printed solutions, Q01, Q02, Q05, Q08, Q15 and Q53; chemical/mathematical notation linearised (^ for superscripts, plain digits for subscripts).
